summary.en: One night, after their restaurant dinner, Kogoro, Ran, and Conan hear a woman scream and then rush to her rescue. They arrived at the scene and find the corpse of a fallen man. Location: Third floor balcony building Victim: Misaki Takizawa Suspects: Takeshi Yaginuma Location: Parking lot Victim: Takeshi Yaginuma Cause of death: Fell from the third floor balcony building Suspects: Misaki Takizawa He was almost pushed to death. During their investigation, Megure and Takagi find that the victim is really the thief who, a week before, had stolen jewelry in the woman house and killed her husband. Robbery - Murder (Past) Location: Takizawa Residence, second floor Victim: Akira Takizawa Time: One week ago, on night Cause of death: Slash wound to the chest Culprit: Takeshi Yaginuma He was stabbed and Takeshi murdered him, and his wife witness him killing her husband.
